title: VLA-GAUGE: Systematically Evaluating Generalization and Robustness in Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.16567v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have achieved high success rates on familiar manipulation tasks, yet it remains unclear whether such scores reflect genuine zero-shot generalization and perturbation robustness. Existing evaluation frameworks provide limited capability-level diagnosis and combinatorial perturbation coverage, often without connecting diagnosis to targeted model refinement. We introduce VLA-GAUGE, a diagnostic framework that unifies both evaluations under a shared executable task representation. It combines (1) paired in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks across six capability suites, (2) single-factor sensitivity analysis with combinatorial perturbation screening and evaluation, and (3) diagnosis-driven refinement through targeted data augmentation and model fine-tuning. tldr: 提出VLA-GAUGE诊断框架，通过统一的可执行任务表示系统评估视觉-语言-动作模型的零样本泛化能力与扰动鲁棒性，并借助诊断驱动的数据增强与微调实现针对性模型改进。
